text: Because autonomous personal mobility systems operate in dynamic public spaces and must continuously perceive and respond to their surroundings, they require precise motion planning and reliable control. In this context, deceleration is a key motion dynamic shaping safety, comfort, and overall user experience in autonomous wheelchair navigation. Previous studies have examined the effects of motion dynamics on passenger experience, establishing a clear link between braking profiles and physical stability.
source_label: Effects of deceleration profiles and driving speed on usability and user perception in autonomous wheelchairs
